jobs.title: Head of Engineering / Futuro CTO
jobs.description:
Head of Engineering / Futuro CTO

Insurtech · España · Presencial/Híbrido Igualada
Desde Kiliia estamos buscando un Head of Engineering y futuro CTO para un proyecto insurtech en el que estamos trabajando.
Sobre el proyecto

Son la primera MGA española especializada en trabajar la confianza entre la empresa y el trabajador. Están construyendo el producto desde cero — tecnología, producto y regulación — con el objetivo de lanzar en enero 2027. Buscamos a la persona que lidere y construya toda la capa tecnológica de la compañía.
El rol

Como Head of Engineering / Futuro CTO liderarás el área de ingeniería y tecnología, definiendo junto al equipo fundador la visión técnica del producto y la arquitectura a largo plazo. En tu día a día coordinarás equipos de desarrollo, priorizarás el roadmap técnico, asegurarás la calidad del software y la entrega a tiempo de los proyectos. Colaborarás estrechamente con producto y negocio para alinear las decisiones técnicas con las necesidades de la empresa, y participarás en la selección de talento y en la construcción de una cultura de ingeniería sólida.
No buscamos a alguien que ejecute tareas. Buscamos al arquitecto técnico del proyecto: la persona que en 3-5 años sea el CTO de una compañía regulada con miles de pólizas bajo gestión.
Hoy el stack es React + Python + PostgreSQL. La arquitectura y las decisiones técnicas estratégicas serán tuyas.
Este es un puesto a tiempo completo, con modalidad híbrida. El puesto está ubicado en Igualada y parte del trabajo se puede realizar desde casa.
Lo que necesitamos

Obligatorio:
Full stack real — frontend en React y backend en Python
PostgreSQL y diseño de bases de datos relacionales
Haber construido y llevado a producción al menos un producto digital desde cero
Haber trabajado en startups, no solo en corporates
Experiencia en proyectos de datos: modelado, optimización, analítica y modelos predictivos
Usar IA en el día a día como herramienta de desarrollo — no como concepto, como práctica real
Capacidad para comunicar ideas técnicas con claridad a perfiles no técnicos
Experiencia en metodologías ágiles (Scrum, Kanban) y herramientas de colaboración (Git, CI/CD, Jira)
Entre 5 y 10 años de experiencia

Valorado muy positivamente:
Experiencia en fintech, insurtech o healthtech
Haber diseñado arquitecturas de datos orientadas a scoring o underwriting
Conocimiento de RGPD y cumplimiento normativo
Haber liderado equipos pequeños (2-5 personas)
Formación en ingeniería informática, telecomunicaciones o disciplinas técnicas afines
Entender de negocio y poder hablar con inversores

Lo que ofrecemos

Un proyecto ambicioso en una categoría de producto sin competencia real en España. Están regulados, con carrier firmado y primeros clientes en pipeline — no es una idea, es una compañía en construcción.
Equity desde el inicio para quien quiera crecer con el proyecto. Y potencial de internacionalización real: el modelo es replicable en cualquier mercado europeo con alta tasa de temporalidad laboral.
Si buscas construir algo que no existe y dejar huella en un mercado, hablemos.
Cómo aplicar

Escríbenos directamente con un ejemplo concreto de algo que hayas construido y llevado a producción.

jobs.title: Desarrollador de back-end
jobs.description:
🔹 Oportunidad en Capitole – Senior Backend Engineer (Node.js / Azure / APIs) 🔹

Descripción del puesto

Buscamos un Senior Backend Engineer para formar parte del equipo de ingeniería responsable del diseño, desarrollo y evolución del backend de una plataforma digital. El candidato seleccionado liderará la construcción de servicios backend escalables, seguros y de alta disponibilidad, enfocados en APIs de negocio, integraciones con sistemas corporativos y de terceros, gestión de identidad y persistencia de datos en Microsoft Azure.

Responsabilidades del puesto

🔹 Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener servicios backend y APIs REST seguras, escalables y orientadas a dominio utilizando Node.js y TypeScript.
🔹 Implementar integraciones con sistemas corporativos y terceros, aplicando patrones de resiliencia (Retry, Circuit Breaker, Rate Limiting, Caching).
🔹 Configurar mecanismos de autenticación y autorización (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT) e integrar proveedores de identidad con Azure Key Vault y principios Secure by Design.
🔹 Desarrollar y desplegar soluciones en Microsoft Azure (Container Apps, App Services, API Management) colaborando en pipelines CI/CD y modelos de datos en PostgreSQL y Redis.

Must Have

🔹 +5 años de experiencia en desarrollo backend y +3 años con Node.js, TypeScript y frameworks como Express.js o NestJS.
🔹 Sólida experiencia en diseño e implementación de APIs REST (OpenAPI/Swagger), Clean Architecture, SOLID, DDD y arquitecturas orientadas a servicios.
🔹 Experiencia práctica en entorno Cloud Microsoft Azure (App Services, Container Apps, API Management, Key Vault, Front Door) e integraciones de sistemas.
🔹 Conocimientos profundos de seguridad web e identidad (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT, IAM) y bases de datos (PostgreSQL, Redis).

Requisitos deseables

🔹 Experiencia previa con el ecosistema Microsoft (.NET, C#, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework).
🔹 Conocimientos en gestión de identidad avanzada (Keycloak, SSO, MFA, Identity Brokering) y observabilidad (Application Insights, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, ELK).
🔹 Experiencia con DevOps y contenedorización (Docker, Kubernetes, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Terraform/Bicep).

💙 ¿Por qué unirte a nosotros?

📘 1.200€ al año en formación
🏥 Seguro médico privado gratuito
🔹 Retribución flexible en transporte, guardería y tickets restaurante
🏋️ ♂️ Acceso a +10K gimnasios por toda España en Wellhub (Gymforless)

🎉 Eventos, team buildings y afterworks cada dos meses
⚽ Patrocinamos nuestro equipo de fútbol si te animas a jugar
🔧 Comunidades tecnológicas inTernas para compartir y crecer juntos

¿Te animas a este gran reto y equipo? 🚀

Empowering People, Unlocking Innovation

El empleado se adherirá a las políticas de seguridad de la información:
· Tendrá acceso a información confidencial relacionada con Capitole y el proyecto en el que está trabajando.
· Deberá cumplir con las políticas de seguridad y las pautas internas de la empresa y del cliente.
· Se le requerirá firmar un NDA.

jobs.title: Fullstack Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Build your future with Sovos.

If you're seeking a career where innovation meets impact, you've come to the right place. As a global leader, Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth while revolutionising how businesses navigate the ever-changing regulatory landscape.

At Sovos, we're dedicated to more than just solving compliance challenges – we're committed to making a positive and lasting difference. Our teams operate on the modern edge of digital technology, working not only to solve complex business challenges but also to enrich our personal, professional, and local communities.

Our purpose-built systems provide the tools you need to thrive in a world where governments demand increased visibility, faster reporting and greater control over business processes. Excited about the possibilities? So are we!

Don’t worry if you don't check all the boxes – apply anyway. We're focused on hiring the right people, not just the "right" resume. It's not about what you've done elsewhere; it's all about what you're capable of doing here.

The Work You'll Do

At Sovos, our Core Platform and AI Platform
are the foundation that dozens of engineering teams build on. We're seeking a Fullstack Senior Engineer
who will design, build, and operate the platform services that power that foundation — services that are reliable, well-documented, and adoptable at scale.

This is a builder role at the center of the Sovos platform strategy. You'll work closely with the Platform Adoption
team to understand how teams are using what you build, close feedback loops quickly, and ensure that what ships is something the broader engineering organization can confidently rely on.

The Fullstack Senior Engineer
will own the design and delivery of platform services that span the Sovos portfolio — from identity and administration to AI capabilities and shared infrastructure
. Your work directly determines what other teams can build and how fast they can build it
.

More Specifically You Will

Building Platform Services That Scale Across the Portfolio

You'll design and deliver the Core Platform and AI Platform services that product teams depend on — things like identity, shared admin experiences, design system components, and AI infrastructure. Adoptability is a first-class requirement: services need to be well-designed, well-documented, and easy to integrate correctly.

Design and implement platform services with clear contracts, versioning strategies, and backward compatibility in mind
Build with adoption as a first-class concern — prioritize APIs, SDKs, and interfaces that are intuitive for consuming teams
Contribute to Core Platform components including identity, Sovos Admin, Mosaic design system, and Sovos Home
Build and maintain AI Platform infrastructure including tooling, integrations, and agentic service components
Establish engineering standards, patterns, and guardrails that make the right way the easy way for consuming teams

Partnering Closely with the Platform Adoption Team

You'll work together with the Senior Developers on the Platform Adoption team who are embedded with consuming teams.

Treat adoption friction as a product defect - actively seek feedback from the Adoption team and act on it
Collaborate on Skills and integration guidance to ensure what gets taught matches what's built
Participate in onboarding sessions, design reviews, and pairing with consuming teams when platform depth is needed
Provide timely support and clear escalation paths for teams hitting blockers in platform integration

Owning Quality, Reliability, and the Path to Production

Platform services are only as good as their uptime, and the confidence teams have in them. You'll lead testing strategies, participate in deployment planning, and take ownership of the operational quality of what you build — because what you ship is someone else's critical path.

Author and maintain comprehensive test plans — unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end — for platform services
Own the deployment lifecycle for platform components from development through staging to production
Establish observability practices (logging, metrics, alerting) so platform health is visible and actionable
Contribute to security and compliance reviews for platform services, particularly those touching identity and data
Participate in on-call rotations and lead incident response for platform-level issues

What We Need From You

7+ years of software engineering experience, with meaningful time building shared services, platforms, or infrastructure consumed by other engineering teams
Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and React for frontend platform components; experience with backend services in Java, .NET, or Node.js
Experience designing APIs, SDKs, or component libraries with developer experience as a primary consideration
Familiarity with identity and authentication patterns (OAuth/OIDC, SAML, SSO) is a strong plus
Experience or genuine enthusiasm for AI tooling, agentic frameworks, and integrating LLM-based capabilities into platform services
Strong instincts for testing strategy - you write tests because you care about what happens after you ship, not because someone asked you to
Excellent communication skills: you can explain platform design decisions and trade-offs to both engineering peers and non-technical stakeholders
A collaborative mindset - you view the teams building on your platform as customers, not consumers

What Does Sovos Offer You?

The tools to enhance your life – because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!

An opportunity to work with a global team
Bi-Weekly Meeting Free Days!
Mentoring Programs
Globally recognised Training and Development programs
Benefits

Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, color, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, national origin, disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.

Company Background

Sovos is a global provider of tax, compliance and trust solutions and services that enable businesses to navigate an increasingly regulated world with true confidence. Purpose-built for always-on compliance capabilities, our scalable IT-driven solutions meet the demands of an evolving and complex global regulatory landscape. Sovos’ cloud-based software platform provides an unparalleled level of integration with business applications and government compliance processes.

More than 100,000 customers in 100+ countries – including half the Fortune 500 – trust Sovos for their compliance needs. Sovos annually processes more than three billion transactions across 19,000 global tax jurisdictions. Bolstered by a robust partner program more than 400 strong, Sovos brings to bear an unrivaled global network for companies across industries and geographies. Founded in 1979, Sovos has operations across the Americas and Europe, and is owned by Hg and TA Associates. For more information visit http://www.sovos.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Twitter .

jobs.title: Senior Scala Developer with Go
jobs.description:
Xebia is a global AI-first, digital transformation, and engineering partner. With over 25 years of experience and a team of 5,000 professionals across 16 countries, we help organizations design and build scalable products, platforms, and data-driven solutions.
We specialize in Artificial Intelligence, Data and Cloud, Intelligent Automation, and Digital Products, combining deep technical expertise with a strong focus on engineering excellence and a people-first culture.
In the CEE region, we’re a team of nearly 1,000 experts delivering modern applications, data platforms, and AI solutions for clients such as Millennium, ING, Play, Edenred, Arabian Drilling, FedEx, Leroy Merlin, Truecaller, Volotea, Schmitz Cargobull, and many, many more. We work with leading technologies including AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks, and Snowflake, and combine strong engineering culture with a consulting mindset and a continuous focus on growth and knowledge sharing.

You will be:

Designing and implementing scalable software solutions using Scala and Go in a distributed environment.
Working with event-driven and asynchronous architectures using Kafka.
Building and supporting high-throughput systems in production.
Work with AWS services, including S3 and EKS, across cloud, container, database, and storage environments.
Contributing to the full software development lifecycle, including CI/CD and testing.
Evaluating technical trade-offs against business requirements and collaborate with stakeholders.

Your profile:

5+ years of professional software engineering experience.
Strong proficiency in Scala and functional programming, with professional experience in Go or the ability to work across both Scala and Go codebases.
Experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs.
Strong understanding of distributed systems and high-throughput production environments.
Hands-on experience with AWS, particularly S3 and EKS.
Experience with Kafka and event-driven or asynchronous architectures.
Experience with the Lightbend ecosystem, particularly Akka.
Experience with Elasticsearch, Jenkins, and New Relic.
Good understanding of software development lifecycle, including source control, CI/CD, and different testing approaches.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
Practical experience using AI-powered assistants (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to improve productivity, quality, or decision-making in software delivery.

Work from the European Union region and a work permit are required.

Nice to have:

Experience applying GenAI in a more structured way within the SDLC, including defined workflows, prompt patterns, or tool integrations embedded into daily work.
Interest in and familiarity with emerging AI-driven practices (e.g. agent-based workflows, automation patterns, AI-augmented development), with a willingness to explore and experiment beyond standard approaches.
